threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look baffled when you hear the train signal cut off mid-station announcement. We locals have learned to guess the rest.
Last night on the 35, a guy started singing Whitney Houston and everyone joined in. The driver just shook his head, smiling. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh kebabs mixed with fresh coffee at 2 AM while dodging a bread roll fight on Sonnenallee. Classic Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find techno parties in former swimming pools. The acoustics are unreal, and the vibe? Completely soaked in nostalgia.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell who's local by how they react when the sirens go off—most just look up, but newcomers freeze like they’re in a horror flick.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus today with an impromptu concert on board. A guy strumming his guitar while we crawled past a block of tourists. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí and plazas, but it's the hidden alleys with quiet bars where the real vibe is. They miss it.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can’t miss the look of pure confusion when they try to navigate the metro map—still clutching a freshly bought ‘T-10’ card, like it’s a treasure map.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You look bewildered at the bus stop, waiting for the 149 like it’s a magic carpet, not realising it'll be late – just like everything else in Dalston.
Heard a guy on the 77 last night arguing with the bus driver about the correct way to pronounce 'Brixton'. You'd think we had bigger issues!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I spotted a guy in flip-flops chatting up a pigeon outside the Späti at 3 AM, I realized Neukölln had officially claimed me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find spontaneous raves in abandoned buildings, complete with DJs spinning till sunrise. It's like a secret club that finds you.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they navigate the BART delays—utter annoyance but no surprise, like it's part of the daily commute script.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw three folks in tuxedos on the 21 bus yesterday, clearly late for a wedding. Gotta love San Francisco's commitment to looking good, even in transit.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's charm is all about the squares and bars, but it's the whispered secrets in the narrow streets that really make it alive.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their struggle with the metro ticket machines—cluelessly pressing buttons, then looking around for help as locals breeze past.
